response.rationale: Bone marrow shows MDS-defining features (5% blasts, dysmegakaryopoiesis, complex karyotype with 5q/7q deletions) and skin biopsy reveals atypical myeloperoxidase-positive cells consistent with leukemic infiltration, favoring MDS over AML (blasts <20%) and other candidates.

rejected.why: Monocyte count is not elevated (8% of low WBC), lacking CMML criteria despite IgA elevation.
Skin biopsy shows atypical mononuclear cells, not classic neutrophilic leukocytoclastic vasculitis.
Blast percentage (5%) is below AML threshold; complex karyotype alone does not establish AML.
Biopsy lacks neutrophilic dermal infiltrate typical of Sweet syndrome; atypical cells are present.
